g.text: Extension wages per item for Germany (DEU), a FABIO-internal decomposition; the World Bank reference is
TOTAL-only, so no WB line is drawn. Taxes less subsidies is the production-side measure throughout. Blue
line/triangles on the Primary (ISIC-A) row(s) = external A01+A03 wages benchmark (EUROSTAT_NAMA; exported by
scripts 02/03), a primary-agriculture, forestry-free reference for the covered years. Items grouped as
"Other" exactly as in the TOTAL figure (below 3% max |share| of WB across years). Rows: primary (ISIC-A) vs
FABIO-v2 value-added extension, GLORIA, wages (current US$)
FABIO-v2 value-added extension, GLORIA, wages (current US$)
